# Balmond Jungle Sustain Check

Balmond is strongest when the map demands repeated contact instead of a single burst answer.

## What to watch

- Stay in the corridor long enough to force bad enemy cooldowns.
- Value objective setup over vanity chase paths.
- Use health advantage to claim space before damage lands.

## Why it matters

He is not a speed jungler; he is a stability jungler with better second-contact value than he gets credit for.

> Balmond matters when the fight refuses to end on first contact.

More on Balmond: keep this read connected to fighter jungle structures, not just isolated mechanics.
